patches.summary: cacheKey sorts param keys before hashing.
patches.reason: Generator-shaped: the generated client built the cache key by ranging over the params map, whose iteration order Go randomises per runtime, so the same (path, params) hashed differently across calls and the GET cache never hit. Reproduces in any generated CLI whose GETs take params.

patches.summary: Added Client.PostWithContext / doCtx (http.NewRequestWithContext) so callers can impose per-request deadlines; advise tiebreaker and compare --timeout now thread their contexts through.
patches.reason: Generator-shaped (client) + CLI: the generated client had no context-aware request path, so advise.go discarded its 8s tiebreak deadline (`_ = ctx`) and compare.go discarded its --timeout (`_ time.Duration`). A slow/unresponsive model could hang the command instead of falling back.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./... && go test ./... ; dry-run inspection of compare/advise

patches.summary: AdaptiveLimiter.Wait reserves the next slot under the lock and advances lastRequest before sleeping.
patches.reason: Generator-shaped: the generated Wait() released the mutex between reading the snapshot and sleeping, so N concurrent goroutines sharing one limiter (compare's fan-out) read the same lastRequest, slept identically, and fired simultaneously — defeating pacing.

patches.summary: refreshAccessToken returns an explicit error when no token endpoint is configured instead of silently no-opping.
patches.reason: Generator-shaped: the generated OAuth2 refresh path returned nil when tokenURL was empty, letting authHeader() proceed to send the expired AccessToken with no signal. ollama-cloud uses static bearer auth (OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY), so this path is dormant in practice, but failing loud is correct.

patches.summary: Recommendation.Fallback now picks the first live candidate that differs from the recommendation.
patches.reason: CLI logic: fallback was hardcoded to live[1], which equals the recommendation once the tiebreaker promotes live[1] to winner (the len>=3 guard does not fire with exactly two live models). A routing layer retrying against fallback would loop back to the same model.

patches.summary: divergence_pct is tallied over all rows in the window, independent of --diverge-only / --limit.
patches.reason: CLI logic: with --diverge-only the displayed set contains only diverged rows, so divergeCount == len(out) and the rate was trivially 100%. The denominator is now the total rows in the window.

patches.summary: Dropped the never-populated est_cost_usd field and the 'cost' claim from every compare surface; compare now emits prompt_hash (matching the advisor log) so its documented envelope is accurate; --prompt-file read errors are surfaced instead of masked.
patches.reason: CLI truth-in-CLI: compare advertised side-by-side cost but never loaded the cost overlay, advertised a prompt_hash that was absent from output, and swallowed prompt-read errors behind a generic usage message.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... ; grep confirms no 'cost' claim remains on any compare surface

patches.reason: The library's new-CLI attribution guard requires a real GitHub handle (printer) and display name (printer_name); the original print predated that guard.
